FORMA STUDIO · PRIVACY & DATA PROTECTION POLICY

Privacy Policy

Effective Date: November 16, 2026 · Version 2.4 · 169 Local Tools
100% LOCAL BROWSER PROCESSING GUARANTEE

All PDF Studio (66 tools), Image Studio (60 tools & 310+ filters), and Calculator & Converter Studio (43 tools) operations execute directly inside your browser using WebAssembly, Web Workers, and HTML5 Canvas. Your private documents, images, and calculations never leave your device unless you explicitly invoke an optional AI assistant tool.

1. Zero Server Upload for Document, Image & Calculator Tools

Forma Studio is engineered as a client-side workstation. When you merge, split, encrypt, redact, bates-stamp, or convert PDFs, or when you resize, crop, apply LUT filters, hide LSB steganography messages, or scan QR/barcodes in Image Studio, all binary byte streams are processed exclusively in volatile browser memory (RAM) on your own device.

  • We do not upload, store, inspect, or log the contents of your PDF or image files on external storage servers.
  • All encoding, cipher, financial, engineering, and scientific calculations in Calculator & Converter Studio run 100% offline in your browser.

2. Firebase Authentication & UID-Isolated Workspace Sync

Forma Studio uses Google Firebase Authentication (Email & Password and Google Sign-In) and Cloud Firestore strictly to provide authenticated access and per-user workspace isolation:

  • Account Identity: When you sign in, Firebase Authentication processes your email address, display name, and unique user identifier (user.uid).
  • UID-Isolated Preferences & Workspace State: Your pinned tools, theme preference, custom multi-step pipeline definitions, and calculation history are keyed strictly to your authenticated user.uid so no other account on the same browser or device can access your workspace.
  • Sign-Out Memory Wipe: Signing out immediately unmounts your active files and clears in-memory session buffers.

3. Browser Permissions & Local Capabilities

Forma Studio respects your device privacy and requests zero intrusive hardware permissions:

  • No Camera, Microphone, or Geolocation: Forma Studio never requests access to your camera, microphone, or GPS location.
  • Optional Completion Notifications: Browser desktop/mobile notifications (Web Notification API) are requested only if you explicitly click the Enable Completion Alerts toggle to be notified when background PDF/Image jobs complete.
  • Clipboard API: Used only when you click Copy or Paste buttons inside a tool.

4. Data Retention, Security & Account Deletion

You retain full ownership and control over your data at all times. You can clear your saved workspace history at any time directly from the profile menu inside Forma Studio (Clear Workspace History), or request complete deletion of your Firebase account record by contacting us.
